messages:
mike_sales: Heads-up — ACME wants Dedicated POC in ap-southeast1. Their reservation is stuck in us-central1 and pool claim returns 409 Conflict. Also pinged about security questionnaire attachment.

emma_csm: Oof. Any error logs from the claim API? They need start-of-week demo.

raj_infra: They hit this on /v1/dedicated/reservations/claim -> response: 409 {"error":"region-mismatch","detail":"reservation assigned to us-central1"} 

patrick_engineer: Can you paste the claim request body? We might be defaulting tenant_affinity to global.

mike_sales: Pasting request:
```json
{"customer_id":"acme-io","wanted_region":"ap-southeast1","pool_type":"A100-40GB","tenant_affinity":"reserved_us-central1"}
```

mike_sales: They say they selected ap-southeast1 in the portal UI.

raj_infra: Hmm portal UI bug suspected — UI allows region override but backend still enforces existing reservation's AZ affinity. I'll try updating the reservation mapping.

devops-bot: deployment-notifier: started reservation-update job for res-98765 (triggered by raj_infra)

patrick_engineer: If we can't move the reservation, fallback is to create a new pool in ap-southeast1 and re-associate the reservation id. Doing that will change billing/pricing — need sales signoff.

emma_csm: I'll confirm timeline with customer. Also they sent a security questionnaire — ask security_team for one-pager on encryption/KMS and VPC options.

security_team: Our standard answer: we support CMEK via customers' KMS (GCP/Azure/AWS), VPC peering, and audit logs. We can attach the template. @mike_sales want us to redact anything?

sam_sales_engineer: Pricing note — dedicated pools in ap-southeast1 have +12% regional surcharge vs us-central1. If we create a new pool, notify finance for quote update.

mike_sales: OK I'll tell customer about potential surcharge and ask if they can accept ap-southeast1 demo delay.

raj_infra: Update: reservation res-98765 reassigned to ap-southeast1 successfully.

devops-bot: deployment-notifier: reservation-update job res-98765 completed — pool active in ap-southeast1

mike_sales: Verified with customer — they can proceed. Thanks everyone :tada:

emma_csm: Marking as resolved, will follow up with post-poc checklist.
